## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector-level strength (Utilities, Energy, Industrials leading) paired with major divergence across large caps (multiple mega-caps show 1W vs 1M disagreement), producing mixed signals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +0.16%), Energy strong: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) and CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%), Industrials strong: DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) and GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: NUE BELOW TREND (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) and DOW CORRECTION (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%), Consumer Staples soft: MDLZ CORRECTION (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) and EL RECOVERY (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%), Technology shows internal weakness over 1M despite 1W strength (see Tech outlook).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%), SHOP RECOVERY (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%), DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%), GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%). Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5: Tech, Energy, Industrials); style: mixed/no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ETN CORRECTION (1W: -4.34% | 1M: +10.48%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%), NUE BELOW TREND (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%), MDLZ CORRECTION (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%). Weakness concentrated in Technology and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%), SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%), OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%). Note major divergence across big names (multiple large caps with 1W up but 1M down — AMZN RECOVERY, GOOGL RECOVERY, SHOP RECOVERY) — tactical watch for trend-breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internals: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%). Sector shows 1W lift but 1M weakness in several large-cap names — internal rotation and dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive 1W action with mixed internals: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%), PYPL RECOVERY (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.20% | 1M: -0.22%). Financials showing short-term strength but divergent 1M performance across names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive but mixed: JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%), UNH RECOVERY (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%). Positive headlines (JNJ, LLY) contrast with short-term dispersion — watch guidance and trial-readouts for confirmation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Industrials and Energy given leadership (DE ABOVE TREND, OXY ABOVE TREND) and rotate select exposure away from tech names with persistent 1M weakness (INTU BELOW TREND, INTC BELOW TREND, ORCL BELOW TREND). Style: mixed — no clear single style to run with while divergence persists.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%). BEARISH: INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials, Energy, Utilities (top 3 1W performers and confirming earnings/news flows). BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples (1W negative and pockets of trend-exhaustion).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) — hold above recent 1M pivot to retain leadership; AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) — watch 1M support for trend confirmation; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) — watch for continuation above recent breakout.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): FDA breakthrough headline; JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) — news bullish but price shows short-term softness (partial divergence). DE (+75): upbeat earnings; DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) — sentiment confirmed by price. OXY (+55): dividend hike; OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+65): trial positive; LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) — news-positive but price lagging (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-45): competitive pressure headlines; INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) — sentiment confirmed by price weakness. UNH (-50): lowered expectations; UNH RECOVERY (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) — negative news but short-term bounce (divergence). Note: overlap between news-sentiment list and detailed price data is limited; prioritize names with both negative headlines and confirmed price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) and OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (multiple 1W/1M disagreements and news-price divergences in JNJ and LLY), so monitor for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
